users.title: User Profiles
users.description: User account information and saved game settings synchronized across devices

lastDailyClaim.description: ISO timestamp of last daily login claim

coinHistory.title: Coin Transaction Ledger
coinHistory.description: Immutable log of all user coin transactions, match rewards, deductions, and streak bonuses

type.description: Transaction category (match_win, match_loss, match_entry, daily_spin, daily_login, quest_reward, referral, ad_reward)

userData.title: User Game Data Backup
userData.description: Cloud backup of all locally saved games, match logs, custom boards, and preferences

gameData.description: Key-value pair game states and settings

rooms.title: Multiplayer Game Rooms
rooms.description: Cloud synchronized game lobby rooms and multiplayer boards

isPrivate.description: Whether room is private or public

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard Records
leaderboard.description: Global player rankings, scores, and tournament standings

systemGovernance.title: System Governance & Emergency Mode
systemGovernance.description: Global application operational state, panic mode shutdown, and emergency maintenance controls

initiatedBy.description: Identity of administrator who engaged panic mode

unlockAt.description: ISO timestamp string when lockdown expires automatically

terminatedAt.description: Server timestamp of manual lockdown termination

terminatedBy.description: Identity of administrator who terminated lockdown

platformState.title: Platform State & Active Game
platformState.description: Global active game mode configuration and platform state synchronized across all clients

activeGameId.description: Identifier of currently active game mode

currency.description: Currency used for entry fee (coins or gems)

switchedBy.description: Admin who switched the game mode

matches.title: Match Session & Entry Fee Settlement
matches.description: Active game matches, players, turn moves, and fee settlement flags

players.description: Map of player IDs to player status and fee settlement

/matches/{matchId}.description: Match sessions with real-time moves and first-move entry fee settlement

/users/{userId}.description: User profile documents accessible and modifiable by the profile owner

/users/{userId}/coin_history/{txId}.description: Immutable audit ledger of user coin awards, match rewards, and transaction records

/user_data/{userId}.description: User cloud save backups accessible and modifiable only by the account owner

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Public and private game lobbies readable by all authenticated players, writable by owner

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Public leaderboard data readable by all players, modifiable by authenticated players

/system/{docId}.description: System-wide governance documents including emergency panic mode status

/platform_state/{docId}.description: Global active game mode and platform state readable by all users, writable only by administrators
